newsitem.title: USA: iMALL names Richard Rosenblatt CEO.
newsitem.headline: iMALL names Richard Rosenblatt CEO.

text.p: iMALL Inc named Richard Rosenblatt, one of the firm's three co-founders and an executive vice president since January 1996, chief executive.

Rosenblatt replaces Tracy Scott who joined the iMALL in October 1996. The company said, "it was the unanimous feeling of the board that the company wanted to go in a different direction for leadership."
The company also said Wednesday it was relocating its corporate headquarters to the Los Angeles area from Provo to reflect iMALL's increased focus on online commerce services.
In another move, iMALL named Mark Comer, another co-founder and executive vice president since January 1996, president. Comer will direct the company's international expansion.
It noted that the newly formed international division is now in the process of forgoing new alliances and expects to have several in place in the near future.
